elements.name: User attempts to Register - form is available

steps.name: I am online at "https://customerapp-neon.vercel.app"
I click on the "ACCOUNT" button
I wait for ajax to complete
I click on the "SIGN IN" button
I wait for ajax to complete
I tab to the "REGISTER" tab
I wait for ajax to complete
I should see the "Full Name *" field
I should see the "Email *" field
I should see the "Phone (optional)" field
I should see the "Password *" field
I should see the "CREATE ACCOUNT" message
